_comment: Curated TAC pool for Norypt Ghost IMEI generation. PHONE-ONLY: every TAC must come from a real smartphone (Apple/Samsung) whose sub-6 5G band set overlaps the RG650V-NA-US (n2/n5/n12/n25/n41/n66/n70/n71/n77/n78). Mobile-hotspot/modem TACs are intentionally EXCLUDED — the device presents as an ordinary phone, not a hotspot. Verify each TAC at https://hicelltek.com/en/tac-lookup/ and include a source URL in each entry. DO NOT add LTE-only TACs; they caused confirmed throttling (GL.iNet forum thread 68449).
_verification_note: PHONE-ONLY pool (smartphones only; no hotspot/modem TACs). All entries are marked verified=false until confirmed against the IMEI/TAC database. Before release, every entry needs a hicelltek source URL and verified=true. Remove any TAC where the device does not support at least n41 or n77 (the primary US 5G bands used by Mudi 7).
